budgetPolicy: Budgets were set on 2026-09-18 from two pnpm bench:kernel runs on the reference host (Apple M4 Pro, 14 cores, 48 GiB, Darwin 27.0.0, APFS, Node 24.17.0, SQLite 3.53.0). Each latency budget bounds p95 at three times the worse measured p95, rounded up; the append-throughput budget bounds the median at one third of the lower measured median, rounded down. The threefold headroom absorbs run-to-run noise and a loaded machine; it is not a claim about any other host.
